# Lakeshore Community College ## 2026-27 Tuition and Fee Schedule Effective Fall Term 2026 | Office of the Registrar ### Residency categories . In-district: you have lived in Lakeshore County for at least 90 days before the first day of the term. . Out-of-district: you live elsewhere in the state, or have lived in the county for fewer than 90 days. . Out-of-state: your permanent address is outside the state. ### Payment options . Pay online through the student portal with a debit card, credit card or bank transfer. . Pay in person at the Cashier's Office, Student Union Room 104, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. . Set up a payment plan: four equal installments with a $35 enrollment fee. Important: Tuition and fees are due in full by Friday, August 7, 2026, or a payment plan must be in place. ### Financial aid and waivers . Students who qualify for federal or state aid can have tuition deducted from their award. Apply at the Financial Aid Office, Student Services Room 118. . Veterans, active-duty service members and their dependents may qualify for a tuition waiver. Bring your discharge papers or orders to the Registrar. . Residents aged 62 and older receive a 50% tuition reduction on space-available courses. ### Tuition and fees by program Tuition is charged per credit hour. Fees apply to every student in the program. The technology fee is charged once per term, regardless of how many credit hours a student takes. Rates are set by the Board of Trustees and may change without notice. Students enrolled through the dual-enrollment program pay the in-district rate.
Program category Program Tuition per credit hour Fees
In-district Out-of- district Out-of- state Technology fee (per term) Lab fee* (per course)
General education English Composition I $118 $236 $354 $45 —
College Algebra $118 $236 $354 $45 —
Biology I (with lab) $118 $236 $354 $45 $60
Health sciences Nursing (ADN) $142 $284 $426 $45 $120
Dental Hygiene $148 $296 $444 $45 $140
Radiologic Technology $145 $290 $435 $45 $135
Technical programs Welding Technology $131 $262 $393 $45 $95
HVAC Technician $131 $262 $393 $45 $85
Cybersecurity $125 $250 $375 $45 $50
\* Charged once for each course section that includes a laboratory. A dash means no lab fee applies. ### Refund schedule 1\. Withdraw before the first day of class: 100% refund of tuition. 2\. Withdraw during the first week: 75% refund. 3\. Withdraw during the second week: 50% refund. 4\. Withdraw after the second week: no refund. Full tuition and refund policies are posted at https://www.example.org/lakeshore/fees
